topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian clonal succession driven by genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of normal stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and the cell of origin across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promoters, chronic inflammation, and stromal interactions shape tumor development and maintenance.

topics.label: Experimental and computational approaches to tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental techniques and computational tools used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multi-factorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors intersect in cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
